note: No warning problem yet: there is no baseline of disclosures to measure against, so every item is tier routine (plan section 6). The indicators below are registered for when Tom writes one; no item carries an indicator_id. UT-IND-3..4 (Tom, 16 Nov 2026) measure the watch register against later takedowns (python tools/undertow.py closing); name-matched lead time is described, never rated, because platforms coin most operation names in the disclosure itself (measured 16 Nov 2026). No anomaly rule and no warning tier before 10 closed rows.

indicators.text: A new disclosure names an operation already on file from a different independent publisher with the same origin.
indicators.rule: independent publishers naming the operation with the same origin rises from 1 to 2 or more

indicators.text: Disclosed networks targeting one country in a quarter exceed that country's own past quarterly count (needs four quarters of history).
indicators.rule: count > median + 3 x MAD of the country's previous quarters, with at least four quarters on file

indicators.text: Lead time from a watch-register row's first report to the platform takedown Tom closes it into (closed_into); the baseline the 16 Nov 2026 numbers chose over name-matched lead time.
indicators.rule: none until 10 rows are closed into a takedown; then describe the median and range only, no rule fires

indicators.text: Share of watch-register rows a platform takedown closes within 12 months of the first report.
indicators.rule: none until 10 rows are 12 months past their first report; then describe the share only, no rule fires
